stock.description: AP Rentals Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on the rental of diverse equipment for the construction, electrical and mechanical (E&M) engineering, and event and entertainment industries. Its geographical reach extends across Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, and the People's Republic of China, with operations organized into Leasing and Trading divisions. Beyond mere equipment provision, the company delivers a full spectrum of support services. These encompass professional equipment planning consultation, convenient outdoor service, and dedicated service stations. Furthermore, AP Rentals manages transportation logistics, precise installation, operational oversight, refueling, ongoing maintenance, and efficient disassembly, complemented by various other technical support and value-added offerings. The extensive inventory of rental equipment includes essential power and energy solutions, high-reach platforms, and material handling machinery. It also features specialized lifting, earthmoving, foundation, road and transportation, tunneling, demolition, and dewatering equipment. In addition to its core rental activities, the company is engaged in the sale and trading of machinery and related parts. This trading segment is supported by services such as repair, maintenance, installation, and delivery. Established in 2004 and headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, AP Rentals Holdings Limited caters to clients predominantly within the construction, E&M engineering, and event and entertainment sectors.
